theorems.name: Submission.rsd_cmr_massOn_eq_ofReal_mul
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U V : Set (Euclid P)) (hVU : V ⊆ U) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (T₀ : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (c : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, T (testFormOnInclusion hVU n ω) = c * T₀ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), W ⊆ V → T.massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal c * T₀.massOn W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
